show.description: Parcel to Paradise is a romantic drama about a single mother and a wealthy businessman who enter into a fake marriage deal, only to find themselves drawn into real love, secrets, and life-changing truths. Blending emotions, humor, and hidden pasts, the story explores how fate delivers unexpected bonds.
